story.so_that: I can select a target account from a list instead of typing a UUID
story.i_want: see a dropdown of available accounts when filling out a transaction form

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dropdown displays available accounts on form load
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user opens the transaction form When the form mounts Then a dropdown shows all available accounts with their names

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dropdown shows account names, not UUIDs
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the accounts dropdown is displayed When a user views the dropdown options Then they see account names like 'Alice Account' not UUID strings

related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given the backend returns empty accounts array When the form is displayed Then empty state is shown
Given a user is not authenticated When they attempt to fetch accounts Then 401 error is returned
